name: lab0xy0 Kbase build host
//: Build host for the lab0xy0 Kbase fuzzing project. See kernel/BUILD-HOST.md.
onCreateCommand     installs the kernel build toolchain (bootstrap.sh).
postCreateCommand   sets up everything that is NOT an apt package and that
otherwise fails confusingly: machine-spec check, git
identity (needed to commit the kernel pin), GitHub SSH
access, gh CLI, and the preflight verdict
hostRequirements below is honoured by GitHub Codespaces to auto-select a
machine that satisfies kernel/scripts/preflight.sh: >=25 GB free disk (40
preferred) and 8-16 GB RAM. The 2-core/8 GB default spec will NOT pass.
Expect NO /dev/kvm here, so QEMU falls back to TCG. Compilation is
unaffected; fuzzing throughput will be poor. That is a known and accepted
Codespaces auto-stops idle sessions and will kill a running make -j.
Raise or disable the idle timeout before building.
